title: Orb photo showing Chris's lost child
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Orb photo showing Chris's lost child, about unspecified at North Carolina, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fact, I have a child. My wife and I lost a child. We have four, but we lost a child. And I was out thinking about him. And um this lonely orb there it comes [snorts] and I took a picture of it and and there was a child.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he often sees glowing balls of light called orbs, says that he and his wife lost one of their children. He says that one night, while he was outside thinking about that son, a lone orb came toward him, and when he photographed it there was a child in the picture, which he takes as a sign of connection with the one they lost.
